name: Shironouchi Youko
source:
Yoko is team leader of the government’s leading anti-supernatural unit. While she lacks paranormal gifts of her own, Yoko is a brilliant tactician and outstanding combatant. She is the lynchpin which holds the team and maintains its successes. Formerly served in the Japanese military.

Hobby: Gun collecting
Talent: Shooting
Likes: Kimchee
Dislikes: Terrorists

[From Nargrakhan's [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175407/http://www.elizar.com/?p=16]review[/url]]
